## About
Mercury Charlies Garage is a full-service shop for vintage cars, classic cars and hot rods, where old school rules and the custom is always right. Charlie has been a custom-car icon on the Central Texas car scene since long before reality TV showed up.
The crew is fabricators, mechanical savants and horsepower wranglers, all vintage car lovers skilled in customization and old-school hot rodding. We revive, rehabilitate and return old cars to their former glory, and we build them for people who love driving their cars.

## Services
- Paint and body restoration: Custom metal work and paint, from a single paint job to a full body restoration.
- Suspension and fabrication: Getting your vintage car to handle better, ride lower and stop better, with the stance done right.
- Custom interior and upholstery: Anything from a small period-correct upholstery repair to a complete custom interior.
- Engine transplants: Swapping engines into vintage cars, set up to run safely and reliably on modern fuels.
- Custom headers and tailpipes: Exhaust work built to fit your car and sound right.

## FAQ
Q: What kinds of cars do you work on?
A: Vintage cars, classic cars, custom cars and traditional hot rods.

- "The acceptable final results of the engine transplant project performed by the Mercury Charlie's crew was marred by their consistent inability to return phone calls or communicate during the process.
Most recently I had a time-critical question for Chris regarding his choice of some engine components.  I called early in the week and spoke with owner's daughter Roxie, who assured me Chris would call just as soon as he finished a phone call he was on.  4 days and one additional  phone message followup later, I finally got a call at end of day on Friday.  By then I had long since given up and just had to make my own decisions without input from Chris.  Looking back during the estimated "two week" project which stretched into over 2 months (and final cost some 60% greater than the initially discussed high range), I was reminded that on numerous incidents I NEVER received a return call for messages left either on voice mail or with the receptionist.

On the other hand, the finished project was generally completed in a professional and knowledgeable manner.  There aren't many shops left that do this kind of work, and I recognize and appreciate that.

On the positive side, I'd be remiss if I didn't mention that Chris made a personal end-of-day trip to my house with some replacement ignition parts, several weeks after I took possession of the completed project and  he even offered to re-install my spark plugs (I declined.. I'm not yet completely helpless).  They are clearly trying hard.  I'm confident that remaining issues will soon be resolved.

Phil A.
